latter_factory_reset.description: Reset to defaults: erases every saved setting (the whole NVS partition, including the Wi-Fi driver's cached network data and RF calibration) and reboots. Compiled-in Wi-Fi credentials and the API key are kept, so the device rejoins Home Assistant unchanged

latter_set_slots.description: Push paginated media/speaker/search browse slots or Area/Site entity control slots to the device

latter_show_notification.description: Wake display, show an on-screen alert banner (priority normal|warning|critical, duration 3-60 s, default 10), optionally play the embedded WAV chime and show a camera snapshot; alert_id > 0 deduplicates repeats

latter_ui_input.description: Remote navigation input: action up|down|left|right|select|back|home (canonical navigation actions); delta overrides the step for directional actions (0 = derive from action)

device_hello.description: Device-initiated handshake sent when Home Assistant connects to the ESPHome API, carrying optional NVS preference sync state

music_browse.description: Browse speakers, favorites, playlists, artists, albums, tracks, radio, or search

set_active_speaker.description: Select the active media_player target for a Latter device

media_command.description: Execute transport, seek, queue, speaker grouping, or play_media command on the active speaker

media_volume.description: Adjust or set volume on the active speaker or volume override target

area_browse.description: Browse Areas, Area domains, or paginated controllable entities

area_action.description: Execute an explicit domain action on an Area or specific entity

set_active_area.description: Set the active Area context for a Latter device (an on-device Area pick). Whether media follows is the Device's Latter setting

remote_action.description: Send a TV/AV remote command or select active remote slot

calendar_fetch.description: Refresh upcoming calendar agenda events for a Latter device

calendar_create_event.description: Create a new event on the primary configured calendar

intercom_broadcast.description: Broadcast a voice announcement to chosen speakers, the speakers in occupied Areas, or every speaker

doorbell_intercom.description: Doorbell talkback and requests (talk_message, quick_reply, listen_start, listen_stop, call_target, unlock_door, set_noise_reduction)

save_custom_color.description: Save a custom RGB accent color from the on-device color wheel

set_dock_apps.description: Save the Home dock apps chosen on the device (Home settings) as the Device's Latter dock setting

set_device_prefs.description: Persist on-device settings edits back to the Device subentry and increment prefs_seq

timer_alarm_state.description: Report on-device countdown timer and alarm ringing state transitions to Home Assistant

device_hello.description: Device-initiated handshake sent by an ESPHome Latter node on API connection to report its contract version, boot ID, and hardware manifest.

music_browse.description: Browse Music Assistant speakers, library, podcasts, queues, lyrics, and artist/album bios and push paginated slots to the ESPHome device.

set_active_speaker.description: Change the active target media_player for the ESPHome device and optionally transfer the active playback queue.

media_volume.description: Set or step the volume, or toggle mute, on the active speaker. If a volume override is mapped for that speaker (for example an AV receiver), the change goes to the override entity.

set_active_area.description: Switch the active area context by area_id or area name. The device's speaker follows to the new area when the device's "Media follows this Device" setting is on. On roaming devices with Voice Follows Me enabled, this also moves the device's Home Assistant Area so area-aware Assist commands target it.

remote_action.description: Select one of the up to 10 configured TV remote slots or send a remote command.

area_browse.description: Browse Home Assistant areas, curated area entities, or home-wide alarm entities and push paginated slots to the ESPHome device.

area_action.description: Execute a normalized area control, light color/Kelvin, thermostat, lock, vacuum, or home security alarm action.

calendar_fetch.description: Refresh upcoming system calendar events and push a 5-slot agenda page to the ESPHome device.

calendar_create_event.description: Create a new event or quick reminder on the primary system calendar and refresh the agenda sensor.

intercom_broadcast.description: Broadcast a TTS announcement or recorded audio clip to chosen speakers, the speakers in occupied Areas ('occupied_areas'), the speakers in a person's current Area ('person.<slug>'), or all online Music Assistant speakers.

media_command.description: Run a playback command (play, pause, toggle, next, previous, stop, seek, play_media, clear_queue) on the active speaker. If the device restarted or slept and its Sendspin buffer is empty, play re-streams the Music Assistant queue.

notify.description: Show an on-screen notification, with an optional chime and an optional camera snapshot, on a specific device, the devices in occupied Areas ('occupied_areas'), the devices assigned to a person ('person.<slug>'), or all displays ('all').

save_custom_color.description: Save a custom hex color from the on-device or Studio Color Wheel into the System-Wide Color Library and apply it to the target device.

set_dock_apps.description: Save a device's Home dock apps (the apps shown, in order; Settings is always last). The device sends this from its Home settings; Studio edits the same setting.

doorbell_intercom.description: Listen to a doorbell camera's noise-reduced audio on a Latter device, reply by push-to-talk or quick reply (spoken with TTS on the camera's media_player), select a carousel camera, unlock the door's lock, or ring other Latter displays with a notification (call_target). There is no live device-to-door audio.

reset_device.description: Reset a Latter device. Device settings erases everything saved on the device (its settings and the Wi-Fi driver's cached data) and restarts it; Wi-Fi credentials and the API key are compiled into the firmware, so it rejoins Home Assistant unchanged. Latter options puts this device's Latter options back to the defaults it got when it was added, keeping its ESPHome binding and its Music Assistant player link.

set_device_prefs.description: Apply on-device preference updates from a bound Latter Device (or admin automation) into the Device's sleep-safe subentry configuration.

timer_alarm_state.description: Event-driven timer and alarm state update reported by a bound Latter Device.
